summary: Brief connection drops no longer fail whole runs, and restored tags land in the right directory.

fixes.title: A dropped connection no longer fails a run
fixes.text: When Microsoft Graph or Exchange Online gives no answer to a read, it is tried once more after a few seconds instead of failing the run. Changes are never sent twice.

fixes.title: Failed runs always say why
fixes.text: A job run that fails now always shows the reason in its run record on the Runs page, not only in its log.

fixes.title: Tamper restores go through the right directory
fixes.text: Restoring a tag on a user synced from on-premises AD is now written in AD by the Hybrid worker. The Tamper event stays open until the restored value is confirmed.

fixes.title: Tamper restores work for mail-enabled cloud users
fixes.text: Restoring a tag on a mail-enabled cloud user now goes through Exchange Online when Entra refuses the change, just as tagging does.
